name: ReadCue Plugin
description: Chrome extension for ReadCue - Save articles and highlights to your ReadCue library from any webpage.
short_description: Save articles to ReadCue with one click

permission_descriptions.justification: Required to access the current webpage's title and URL to save articles to your ReadCue library without requiring manual input.
Allows the extension to securely communicate with ReadCue servers (readcue.me) to authenticate users and store their saved articles and highlights.
Used to inject content scripts that capture article content, text highlights, and page metadata to enable seamless article saving.
Stores your authentication token locally in your browser to keep you logged into ReadCue without requiring re-entry of credentials.
